def snap(f):
    m={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if r1-r0==1 and c1-c0==1: m[(r0,c0)]=n['color']
    return m
cur=snap(current_frame)
print("before: (28,15)=",cur.get((28,15))," (28,45)=",cur.get((28,45)))
seq=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':41,'col':26},

     {'action':'MOUSE','row':41,'col':38},

action(seq)
fin=snap(current_frame)
print("after: (28,15)=",fin.get((28,15))," (28,45)=",fin.get((28,45)))
print("result:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward','board_changed','stopped_early')})
</parameter>
